327331.title: The Dirt
327331.overview: The story of Mötley Crüe and their rise from the Sunset Strip club scene of the early 1980s to superstardom.

791523.title: Wildwood
791523.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

931939.title: Jumprava: The Big Happening
931939.overview: The epic story of one of the most iconic Latvian rock bands – Jumprava [Yumpravah]. The feature film tells the story about how the electronic rock group Jumprava was founded in 1984 and how it evolved throughout the years until 1991. With their songs and their unique style, Jumprava encouraged the “third awakening” in Latvia and inspired young people to dream big on this side of the Iron Curtain.

1001315.title: The Arab
1001315.overview: Haroun is an old bachelor who has lived in Oran for several years. A retired civil servant, he leads a reclusive life until the day he meets Kamel in a bar—a journalist to whom he tells an incredible story dating back to 1942. He claims to be the brother of ‘the Arab’ killed in a story told in one of the most famous novels of the 20th century, ‘The Stranger’ by Albert Camus. An Arab with an erased name: Moussa. Through anger, assertions, details, and confidences, Haroun finally convinces the journalist to listen to his story. His confession is a cry of freedom and distress—but above all, a cry of revolt: against an abusive mother, against a country that failed to achieve true independence, against a book, and against a famous French writer.

1102883.title: Mother Mary
1102883.overview: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

1107171.title: New Beginnings
1107171.overview: Al Moon lives a solitary life on the territory of the Yurok nation in California. Surrounded by violence and ecological threats affecting his people, buried anxieties from his time in Vietnam now begin to resurface. Driven by an urge to confront his past, Al Moon embarks on a cross-country journey, moving closer to uncovering a truth that has haunted him for decades.

1243747.title: Troublemaker
1243747.overview: Newly discovered audio interviews with Nelson Mandela himself delivers an honest, accurate and definitive depiction of the man who remains a global symbol of justice, hope and universal human dignity.

1245859.title: Savage House
1245859.overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

1255779.title: Une fille en or
1255779.overview: On the day Clémence realizes that no one has ever admired her, her father dies. Lulled by the illusions of the remnants of a complicated childhood, Clémence has no choice but to rebuild her self-esteem, which she never thought could be so low. When fate brings her together with a certain Paul, whom everyone nicknames Paul Pot because of his strong tendency toward tyranny, Clémence asks herself the only question that matters: is this the right person?

1260643.title: Man on the Run
1260643.overview: Paul McCartney forms new band Wings after Beatles breakup. Archival home footage shows his life with Linda, who influenced his music. The film follows Wings from formation through the 1970s, during which McCartney wrote hit songs.

1296227.title: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan
1296227.overview: A debt-ridden, former vocalist relocates to his remote Papuan hometown under the pretense of visiting his terminally ill adoptive mother, masking a sinister plot to plunder her estate that inadvertently unleashes a lethal, ancient supernatural entity.
1296227.trailerName: Suanggi: Ilmu Kutukan - Official Final Trailer

1303331.title: Dhamaal 4
1303331.overview: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

1356963.title: Little Lorraine
1356963.overview: Little Lorraine, a North Atlantic seaside town with a population of 60, becomes embroiled in an international cocaine smuggling operation under the noses of multiple governments, distributed in coffins through a network of funeral homes.

1363043.title: ForeFans
1363043.overview: A naive international student struggling to make ends meet decides to try webcam modeling to support herself financially. But within the lurid online world where every body is treated as a commodity, what will the ultimate price be?
1363043.trailerName: ForeFans Official Trailer 2026 | Log On. Lose Yourself.

1379747.title: Death Has No Master
1379747.overview: Caro travels to Venezuela to sell her late father’s cacao plantation, only to find the family mansion occupied by its former staff, who are determined to remain at all costs. As Caro takes justice into her own hands to claim the inheritance she believes is hers, she sets off a struggle that unearths the violence buried in the land and its memory.

1381027.title: Good Boy
1381027.overview: Tommy, a volatile 19-year-old, revels in drugs, parties and violence. After getting separated from his friends on a drunken bender, he is abducted by a shadowy figure. He wakes to find himself imprisoned in the basement of a remote Yorkshire house, inhabited by a very strange family. But what unfolds is not what he could possibly expect.

1386467.title: The Mage
1386467.overview: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

1388771.title: The Fairfield County Four
1388771.overview: Four young adults disappear while investigating reports of a large, wolf-like creature. Though no trace of the four was found, their camera was eventually located. This would be the last known footage of The Fairfield County Four.
1388771.trailerName: The Fairfield County Four | Found Footage Horror Campaign Teaser

1394275.title: No More History Without Us
1394275.overview: Submerged in the sea of greenwashing that drowns them daily, two Amazonian filmmakers have decided to denounce, in this film manifesto, the entrails of the historical process of inventing and exploiting the forest as an inexhaustible Garden of Eden. Between Munich and Belém, they reveal how racism and prejudice, in Brazil and throughout the world, are still organised around the idea of a “savage demographic emptiness”, unable to speak for itself.

1399459.title: Eurotrash
1399459.overview: A writer sets off on a road trip through Switzerland with his drunk and terminally ill mother, after realizing his wealthy family members are the very worst kind of people.

1413731.title: WrestleHer
1413731.overview: Women's wrestling is the fastest-growing sport in America. But it's still not fully sanctioned. In Ohio, a wrestling hotbed, girls must compete for their titles - and fight for their sport to be recognized.

1418531.title: A Story About Fire
1418531.overview: The legend of Ran Bi Wa talks about a monkey who was raised by humans. When he sets off to the Holy Mountain to steal fire for humankind, a journey begins from which he will return transformed into a man.

1421155.title: Ikatan Darah
1421155.overview: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.

1432547.title: ALL YOU NEED IS KILL
1432547.overview: When a massive alien flower known as "Darol" unexpectedly erupts in a deadly event, unleashing monstrous creatures that decimate the population of Japan, Rita is caught in the destruction—and killed. But then she wakes up again. And again. Caught in an endless time loop, Rita must navigate the trauma and repetition of death until she crosses paths with Keiji, a shy young man trapped in the same cycle. Together, they fight to break free from the loop and find meaning in the chaos around them.

1436835.title: NFT: Cursed Images
1436835.overview: A group of crypto savvy friends begin experiencing strange occurrences after buying into a cursed NFT collection.

1442211.title: Balandrau: Where the Fierce Wind Blew
1442211.overview: On December 30, 2000, a group of friends climbed Balandrau, but an unpredictable blizzard unleashed the worst Pyrenees storm in history.

1447971.title: Scare Out
1447971.overview: After a critical intelligence leak, a national security unit launches an intensive investigation. But successive setbacks in their arrest operations reveal a shocking truth: the trail leads back to within the unit itself. Amidst a storm of trust and betrayal, a silent battle begins to unfold...

1455011.title: The Brothers Gruff go on a Holiday
1455011.overview: Brothers Gruff decide to have the holiday of a lifetime, but they run into big problems when their dream hotel turns out to be run by a troll who would rather eat his guests!

1464099.title: Ethan Bloom
1464099.overview: A coming-of-age comedy about a teen who wrestles with loss, spiritual identity, and first love.

1465827.title: The Travel Companion
1465827.overview: Simon, a struggling documentary filmmaker, enjoys free flights courtesy of his best friend and roommate, Bruce, who works for an airline. However, when Beatrice, a more successful filmmaker, enters the picture and starts dating Bruce, Simon risks flying too close to the sun.
1465827.trailerName: THE TRAVEL COMPANION Official Trailer   Oscilloscope Laboratories HD

1473635.title: Things Unspoken
1473635.overview: Carlo and Elisa are a successful couple. He’s a university professor and writer facing a creative block; she’s a brilliant, sharp-witted journalist, known for her internationally published editorials. They live in Rome, moving between accomplishments and routine, affection and something that might be fading. In search of new energy, they travel to Morocco with their lifelong friends, Anna and Paolo, and their thirteen-year-old daughter Vittoria—bright, curious, a little eccentric. Tensions soon rise.

1478243.title: The Idiot(s)
1478243.overview: Fyodor Dostoyevsky and his wife Anna travel to Europe for their honeymoon and end up staying in a health resort in Switzerland, only to return to Russia after four years. Fyedya can’t shake his roulette habit and keeps losing their money. His wife accepts this fate since he keeps assuring her that it’s all for inspiration and soon he shall write his to-be masterpiece, 'The Idiot'.

1479651.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Eugene Onegin
1479651.overview: Tchaikovsky’s many moods—tender, grand, melancholy—are all given free rein in Eugene Onegin. The opera is based on Pushkin’s iconic verse novel, which reimagines the Byronic romantic anti-hero as the definitive bored Russian aristocrat caught between convention and ennui; Tchaikovsky, similarly, took Western European operatic forms and transformed them into an authentic and undeniably Russian work. At the core of the opera is the young girl Tatiana, who grows from a sentimental adolescent into a complete woman in one of the operatic stage’s most convincing character developments.

1481379.title: Delivery Man
1481379.overview: Guy, a reclusive food delivery rider, develops feelings for Sai, a woman he delivers to regularly. His obsession soon borders on stalking — even though Sai is already married to Dith.

1487395.title: The Chosen: Crucifixion
1487395.overview: The sixth season finale of the popular Biblical television series, following Jesus' arrest and trial leading up to His crucifixion.

1493859.title: Pizza Movie
1493859.overview: A group of college students go downstairs to their dorm lobby to get a delivery pizza. There's only one issue: They're insanely high on a homemade drug, turning their simple journey down two sets of stairs into a mind-bendingly transformative quest.

1498915.title: The Day She Returns
1498915.overview: She has just finished the shoot of an independent film and now has to give three interviews about it. Afterwards, in her acting class, her teacher asks her to reenact the interviews. But for some reason, she is unable to remember them.
1498915.trailerName: Geunyeoga doraon nal (The Day She Returns) Trailer | Berlin International Film Festival 2026

1510435.title: Celtic Utopia
1510435.overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.
1510435.trailerName: Celtic Utopia (2025) | The future of 'offensive' Irish folk music

1521571.title: Celestino
1521571.overview: Ivan, a Belgian journalist on sabbatical in Mexico, starts following the trail of a mysterious writer called Celestino Pérez. Upon arrival in the village where Celestino lives, he turns out to be absent. Ivan is taken in by the writer's family. He soon finds himself trapped in their house, mirroring his own experience with his imagination about Celestino.

1525987.title: The Glimmering
1525987.overview: A man who studies Mongolian history enjoys happy life with his wife. But one day after the president declares martial law, he loses his wife in a sudden accident. Struck by the immense shock, he loses his ability to speak. Now, the man must find his voice again in order to speak with the spirit of his departed wife.

1527075.title: Andhar
1527075.overview: In an isolated house where flowers wilt at a touch and time refuses to move in a straight line, a fragile young widow begins a new life, with a much older husband, she can't quite trust - haunted by warnings, watched by something patient, and carrying a secret that isn't only her own. When an impossible death draws a sharp-witted detective into the house's orbit, he finds a place that bends memory, guards an ancient purpose, and refuses to let anyone leave unchanged. What waits beneath is older than the walls, and the answer, when it comes at dawn, will reach further than anyone expects.

1529379.title: Kingdom of Crooked Mirrors
1529379.overview: Olya lives with her grandmother, who loves to tell her magical stories. Her parents are always busy and are rarely at home. The girl quarrels with her family and accidentally ends up in the mirror kingdom from her grandmother's stories, where she meets her reflection - Yalo. In this world, all people are too absorbed in mirrors, because in them they see ideal versions of themselves. These magic mirrors were invented by Korshun to subjugate the entire kingdom to his power, and Olya will have to believe in a miracle and save the fairy-tale world.

1536163.title: Up Against It
1536163.overview: Álvaro and his ex-wife Saffron attempt to set aside the drama of their messy divorce for the sake of their daughter Rose.

1537635.title: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man
1537635.overview: Peter Asher’s extraordinary life has intersected with some of the greatest artists and musical moments of the last six decades. A child actor who became a pop star and then a manager and producer to the likes of James Taylor and Linda Ronstadt, he is a Zelig-like figure who remains a vital creative force to this day. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Carole King, and many more.
1537635.trailerName: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man | Official Trailer

1539299.title: Power to the People: John & Yoko Live in NYC
1539299.overview: John & Yoko/Plastic Ono Band with Elephant's Memory and Special Guests performed these now-legendary sold-out One To One concerts to a combined audience of 40,000 people, raising over $1.5M for children with intellectual and developmental disabilities. They were the only full-length concerts John Lennon (with Yoko Ono) performed after leaving The Beatles.

1544163.title: Words of Love
1544163.overview: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

1560163.title: Heaven's Office Games
1560163.overview: Four carefree bachelors get into a car accident after a night of partying and find themselves in purgatory — a world of endless bureaucracy and chaotic digital reforms. At the Heaven’s Office, they receive their sentence: a direct express train to hell. Using their charm, they convince the purgatory secretary to give them a chance — seven days on Earth to atone for their sins. But once back, they realize they’ve fallen into a trap hidden in the perfectly ironic fine print of heaven.

1561315.title: For Those
1561315.overview: Armenia, Spring 2021. Léon, a Frenchman of Armenian descent, returns to his family to bury his cousin Hrant, who died six months earlier during the 44-day war.

1567203.title: The Convenience Store
1567203.overview: Yukino, a part-time worker at a convenience store, and the strange experience she has when she encounters a mysterious customer in the middle of the night.

1584483.title: The Producer
1584483.overview: Tom, a young ambitious producer starts spiralling three years into his career when he begins hearing voices and seeing himself in ways that frighten him.

1599779.title: The Fabulous Time Machine
1599779.overview: What if it were possible to travel back in time to dream of other futures? In the hinterlands of Brazil, young girls navigate the delicate transition from childhood to adolescence while grappling with social media, religion, their dreams, and the stories of the women who came before them. By inventing a time machine, they revisit the pasts of their mothers and grandmothers and imagine a future in which they can be free, fulfilled, and in control of their own choices.

1601507.title: Whispers of a Burning Scent
1601507.overview: On the day of a decisive court hearing and an important wedding performance, a quiet wedding musician finds his private life exposed to public scrutiny. Accused of exploiting his marriage, he moves between courtroom, city streets and stage, carrying the weight of judgment, loyalty, and unspoken guilt.

1608547.title: O’Sey Balamma
1608547.overview: During the Sankranti festival celebrations, a matriarch and her housekeeper confront solitude through the intimacy of each other’s company.

1615907.title: Agnes
1615907.overview: Under pressure from her adult daughter to move and become a live-in babysitter, 74-year old Agnes finds agency in an unexpected place.

1615971.title: The Dream of a Ridiculous Man
1615971.overview: A man recalls a single night in his youth when he was on the brink of suicide, and the dream that changed him.

1616163.title: Roya
1616163.overview: Roya, an Iranian teacher imprisoned in Tehran’s Evin Prison for her political beliefs, is faced with a choice: make a forced televised confession or remain confined to her three-square-metre cell. As past and present slip out of sequence and exchange places, she moves between inner landscapes and lived experience.

1620963.title: Shaving
1620963.overview: Three years after escaping an abusive relationship, Suyeon retreats to her father's rural mansion to rebuild her life, writing horror fiction by day. When her caring boyfriend Shinji arrives for the holidays, a strange cut from a rusted razor sets something in motion. Something that wears his face but isn't him anymore. Isolated, with nowhere to run, they can no longer tell nightmare from reality as something begins to hunt them down.

1624419.title: Lagan Laagii Re
1624419.overview: A young woman struggles to come to terms with the end of her relationship.
1624419.trailerName: Lagan Laagii Re- TRAILER | Mallhar Thakar, Aarohi, Tatsat | New Gujarati Film | Releasing on 6th Feb

1624675.title: Petrov and Vasechkin: Heroes of Our Time
1624675.overview: Petrov, Vasechkin and Masha go on an excursion to Lermontov places in Pyatigorsk. Having met their old friend, the Strange Janitor, the trio gets... into the nineteenth century! Friends decide that this is their chance to save the life of the legendary poet and prevent a fatal duel. This is how the newest, ordinary and incredible adventures of Petrov and Vasechkin in the Caucasus mountains begin.
1624675.trailerName: Новейшие приключения Петрова и Васечкина в горах Кавказа — Лев Зулькарнаев и Никита Ефремов

1628323.title: The Three Urns
1628323.overview: Back in his home country to spread the ashes of his beloved wife, a man races to his destination. In a milk float. Chased by a beautiful French woman in a smart car, plagued with battery issues.

1628899.title: Concrete Land
1628899.overview: An intimate story of three generations of a Palestinian Bedouin family in Jordan.

1629795.title: Blasphemous
1629795.overview: Two clerics – a rookie priest and his devout mentor must transport a possessed young woman to a secure location for an exorcism. All hell breaks loose when she unexpectedly escapes, putting their lives on the line and their faith to the ultimate test.

1630307.title: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
1630307.overview: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

1630435.title: THE A-CARE -Disusebody-
1630435.overview: At the "Ijinzaka Clinic" day service, a revolutionary treatment devised by Director Urushihara is secretly spreading among the elderly. Aiming for the ultimate cost-effective care, the amputation of "Disusebody" (limbs with no hope of recovery) has reportedly led to unexpected positive side effects, such as patients feeling "lighter in body and mind" or "developing a gentler personality." Yagura, an editor who hears these rumors, senses a potential revolution in geriatric medicine and proposes a book deal to Urushihara. However, an internal whistleblower leak about the daycare center soon surfaces in a weekly magazine. Following a shocking incident at a patient's home, everything begins to spiral into darkness.

1641315.title: Fourth Floor
1641315.overview: Drawn Back to Chennai by an Unexpected Call From His Former Lover, Dheeren Travels From Mumbai and Checks Into a Secluded Office Guest House. Soon After His Arrival, Disturbing and Inexplicable Events Begin to Unfold Within Its Walls. Night After Night, Dheeren is Plagued by Vivid Dreams—fragments of Memories That Eerily Mirror His Own Past and Unresolved Relationship.  As the Line Between Dreams and Reality Begins to Blur, Dheeren Realizes These Visions Are Not Random. Each Dream is a Clue, Slowly Pulling Him Toward a Buried Truth Connected to His Ex-lover’s Fate. Trapped Between Guilt, Fear, and the Supernatural, Dheeren Must Confront His Past to Uncover What Truly Happened to Her—before the Guest House Claims Him as Its Next Secret.

1645603.title: Night of the Living Dead
1645603.overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

1646115.title: Deep Dive
1646115.overview: After her family is murdered, a champion swimmer infiltrates the killer's home-ready to drown his world in vengeance.

1648099.title: When Worlds Collide
1648099.overview: Lana Maxwell becomes the prime suspect in the murder of her friend Veronica. Watch as her life unfolds and she deals with the challenges that being a teenager brings. Meanwhile Evelyn Jackson is going through friend group problems, and decides to make friends with a controversial figure.

1649187.title: Para los jóvenes: a 20 años del 2006

1658787.title: 823 Hostage Crisis
1658787.overview: Early one morning in a Southeast Asian tourist destination, dismissed police officer Paisa approaches a Japanese tour bus—but it drives away.Parked in front of him is another bus, carrying a group of Hong Kong tourists. Among them, Elaine chats with her boyfriend Wang Jinming, holding a souvenir she plans to bring back to her son.A brief delay keeps the bus from leaving on time.Moments later, Paisa—this time armed—steps onboard.Nothing will be the same again.

1666787.title: Avedon
1666787.overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

1670563.title: Thanks for Coming
1670563.overview: Alain is getting older. For years he has been filming his daily life: his partner Françoise, the people he meets, nature and animals, and life in all its splendour and cruelty. Having devoted his entire life to filmmaking, with the camera as an extension of his arm, he has observed the world with a poetic sense of authenticity and simplicity. Otherness, the approach of death, the power of life and the importance of others intertwine as he looks back on his life as a filmmaker and as a man, concealing nothing, and offering a vision of the universality of the human experience.
1670563.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 와줘서 고맙다는 거장의 인사 Thanks for Coming | 아이콘

1678947.title: Calling You
1678947.overview: After a middle-aged father falls mysteriously into a coma that transports him to an idealised version of his past, his daughter must do all things necessary to rescue him from an eternal trap.

1683683.title: DCI 2026: Big, Loud and Live
1683683.overview: Experience the thunderous power and precision of the world’s finest marching music ensembles. “Big, Loud & Live” brings the 2026 Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims to the big screen, broadcast live from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Beyond your average halftime show, the talented ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League blend world-class musicianship with breathtaking choreography and spellbinding visual formations. You’ll have the best seat in the house to witness the top 15 drum corps go head-to-head competing for their shot at the 2026 DCI World Championship title. From the earth-shaking roar of the brass to the lightning-fast precision of the percussion and color guard, see and hear every detail in stunning high definition. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or looking for a one-of-a-kind, live musical event, this is the ultimate way to experience the pinnacle of the marching arts.

1683939.title: Holy Crowd
1683939.overview: After Ratna rises from the dead during her funeral, her silent body begins performing unexplained healings, turning her husband Arif into the reluctant center of a growing frenzy. As villagers, opportunists, and religious authorities descend, faith and exploitation collide, and the miracle spirals beyond control.

1685539.title: Heaven in Stone and Glass
1685539.overview: On April 15, 2019, the world watched in horror as flames erupted from the rafters of Notre-Dame Cathedral – an event that captivated global audiences and ignited an overwhelming response of loss, awe, and shared cultural grief. Why did the threat to this sacred space resonate so deeply, even among those with no religious affiliation? Bishop Robert Barron returns to France to answer this question, taking the viewer on a cinematic pilgrimage.

1685923.title: Mulher Papaya
1685923.overview: At nearly 70, Hilda's solitude shifts when a domestic accident and a caregiver’s touch awaken long-buried sensations, leading to a personal awakening.

1688163.title: Hayok
1688163.overview: A feisty thriller about a fiercely independent woman who becomes the obsession of a contractor desperate to possess her. But when betrayal turns violent, she strikes back with a revenge that destroys his pride and control.
1688163.trailerName: Hayok Official Trailer | VMX | Apphle Celso, Stephanie Raz, Nico Locco, Chester Grecia

1688867.title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
1688867.overview: DERNSIE is an intimate portrait of Bruce Dern—tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation—whose endurance has shaped both a turbulent life and one of Hollywood’s most enduring careers. A relentless runner on and off screen, Dern has outlasted the very industry that defined him.

1691363.title: Time of Death
1691363.overview: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

1691427.title: Petey & I
1691427.overview: Albert Minogue is a grieving father looking for spiritual reconciliation, instead he discovers a baby alien called Petey who he believes to be a reincarnation of his deceased son.

1693539.title: INCARNATUS
1693539.overview: Brian, a manosphere crazed incel reaches his breaking point

1694051.title: Thirdwheel
1694051.overview: Jess and Joey have grown up beside each other, from family problems to teenage drama- they have always been there for one another.  When a new boy enters their world, it disrupts their comfortable pattern. A once safe place for both girls turns into a jealous ridden and unstable relationship.  As each girl is tested- will they be able to trust themselves and live authentically.

1694435.title: The Adventures of Slinger the Cowboy Rat
1694435.overview: Set deep in the desert, this three-and-a-half-minute short follows Slinger, a cowboy rat who duels supernatural creatures.

1694947.title: Best Friends
1694947.overview: Robert doesn’t wake, dress, or even shave without the help of his best friends, Ewa and Adam. He has outsourced his whole existence, delegating every practical and emotional detail of his life. As the day of a career-defining interview unfolds, subtle cracks begin to appear. Faced with a situation that demands independence, Robert starts to question not only his own abilities, but also how much of himself he has already surrendered.

1695203.title: Limelight
1695203.overview: Following an encounter with the Irish Mob, an Actor (Theo Creager) copes with his new life inside the Witness Protection Program.

1698595.title: Carnal Inferno
1698595.overview: The tale of Mark Benway, a boxer who takes a punch that sends him into a world no man wants to go and one that he may never leave.
1698595.trailerName: Carnal Inferno Official Trailer | An Indie Horror Short | Official Trailer

1699171.title: Light Leak
1699171.overview: After her grandfather dies of cancer, Weronika finds his old camera and photobook. Looking to work through her grief, she takes up what he left behind in hopes to keep his memory alive through photography.

1701219.title: When the Mountains Shook
1701219.overview: The world that appears calm on the surface is, in fact, quietly changing. One day, a man as unshakable as a mountain fell because of a toothache.

1701539.title: Executioner
1701539.overview: A high profile politician foils a blackmail plot and devises a shocking plan for retribution. Based on the hit play 'Deadlock'.

1701731.title: Rationale
1701731.overview: Torn on coming out to his parents, a teenage boy turns to his friend for a second opinion.

1703843.title: Ecoado - Orion: Histórias Depois do Fim

1705379.title: No Hard Feelings
1705379.overview: Down-on-his-luck ride-hailing driver Li Song eases his frustrations via an obscure podcast, held back from new romance by an embarrassing chronic ailment. Yin, pretending to be a Korean customer service agent at a health-supplement firm, drudges through client calls to save for an apartment. A follow-up phone call draws these two lonely urban strangers together behind lies. As reality and delusion crumble, they are forced to confront life and their true selves.

1706723.title: 3 Weeks After
1706723.overview: When a school trip leaves a group of teenagers stranded far from home, the recent suicide of a classmate begins to expose the fractures, loyalties and secrets holding them together.

1707363.title: City of Fathers
1707363.overview: A father and son have nothing in common except a first name, Richard, and an apartment on a housing estate. The burly, good-natured, 30-something factory worker listens to heavy metal and occasionally lets his girlfriend into his life. The frail, retired teacher, who raised the boy after his mother’s departure, is the embodiment of care and understanding. However, their tranquil, shared reality, which embraces both the hardcore band Našrot and Bergman’s “Cries and Whispers,” is disrupted by the sudden death of the mother. Young Richard sets out on a peculiar initiation journey with bizarre encounters and moments of unexpected enlightenment.

1707619.title: THE APE OF GOD
1707619.overview: A happening that connects perspectives of lost souls discovering a mysterious chain of voyeurism and obsession, that leads them to encounter the devil.

1708515.title: Kick Rocks
1708515.overview: A  self-loathing man sits on a park bench and talks to a squirrel.

1708579.title: The Clearing
1708579.overview: Sumatra, early twentieth century. The exploitation of rubber by Dutch colonisers leads to the sexual enslavement of female workers. Archival and contemporary images intertwine in a documentary fabulation that plunges into the depth of a long-erased history.

1710563.title: Nizhal
1710563.overview: NIZHAL follows twin sisters Ramya and Saranya. Saranya is a trainee doctor, and Ramya helps their vendor parents. Tragedy strikes when Saranya’s friend Lakshmi is brutally murdered in the hospital lab by Guna, the CEO's son, and his gang. Ramya witnesses the crime and narrowly survives a deadly attack by them. Driven by fury, Saranya seeks vengeance and puts the killers on their deathbeds. Ironically, her lover Raghu takes charge as the sub-inspector for this very case. When Raghu uncovers the truth, a gripping battle begins between law, love, and ultimate justice.
1710563.trailerName: NIZHAL OFFICIAL TRAILER | TAMIL | JANANY KJ | VISHAKAN | ABUBAKKAR | AK KUMAR | GIANT MUSIC INDIA

1711651.title: Carver
1711651.overview: A hangout between two brothers experiences unexplainable and intrusive interruptions.

1711907.title: Day One
1711907.overview: While trying to take their dying friend to see Avengers: Doomsday on opening day, a trio of close friends gets trapped on the 50th floor of a condo after a blackout kills the elevators. They must find a way down before the movie starts.

1712035.title: Empty Places
1712035.overview: Four friends convene at a café and engage in a peculiar game entitled "Empty Space". Thereafter, their paths diverge for a prolonged period. Each endeavours to find self-realisation through various forms of creative activity, seeking to impose their minor and superfluous art upon a vast and indifferent world.

1713571.title: Veerabhadrudu
1713571.overview: Binu and her father travel to Chennai for her liver transplant, but the gold meant to fund her treatment is stolen, trapping them in a corrupt legal system. As corruption and judicial delays claim Binu's life, her father invokes the guardian deity Veerabhadrudu through a ritual. Suriya, as Veerabhadrudu, descends in the form of advocate Saravana, emerging as a divine force to deliver justice
1713571.trailerName: Karuppu (Telugu) - Teaser | Suriya | RJB | Trisha | @SaiAbhyankkar | Dream Warrior Pictures

1713763.title: Igor and After
1713763.overview: This year’s gallery of artistically inspiring portraits of uncompromising eccentrics (among them The Hanging of Stuart Cornfeld, Robert Richardson: The White Devil and A Pint of Ink) features another unobtrusive stand-out in the shape of Igor Luther, a key figure of Slovak and European cinematography. Ivan Ostrochovský’s perspective is rare, dynamic and also meditative, while Luther himself co-authored the project during the last few months of his life. Works such as Juraj Jakubisko’s Birds, Orphans and Fools, Volker Schlöndorff’s The Tin Drum and Andrzej Wajda’s Danton, in the persuasive words of their creators, wouldn't have the same timeless energy today if it weren't for Luther's visionary endeavours.

1715235.title: Old Man River
1715235.overview: Old Man River continues Iyabo Kwayana’s exploration of lineage, memory and inheritance through an intimate portrait of her father, a 100-year-old political activist and nation builder from Guyana who helped found the country’s first multiethnic political party. The film sits beside him as he reflects on a lifetime shaped by political struggle, idealism, sacrifice and the contradictions within revolutionary movements.

1715491.title: Heidi Wrangles Cats
1715491.overview: A young woman quits her day job to help Brooklyn's street cats. Along the way, she builds a social media following that financially sustains her rescue efforts.

1717027.title: Gorilla Sincere
1717027.overview: Robert Gorilla, a swindling estate agent, showcases a brand new property nestled in a lively yet peaceful neighbourhood.

1717283.title: Hôtel Terminus
1717283.overview: December 31. The concierge of a luxurious seaside hotel deals with the guests' reactions after they learn about the imminent threat of a nuclear war.

1720227.title: Chupa Chupi
1720227.overview: A harmless prank by four mischievous boys sparks panic and fear in a remote village haunted by decades-old superstitions.
1720227.trailerName: CHUPA CHUPI Official Trailer | In Cinemas June12 | Pranab Bharali |Atlas Creation | DJ Entertainment

1720291.title: Ось
1720291.overview: Shy security guard Anton secretly watches the rehearsals of the talented musician Tanya and dreams of one day performing on stage alongside her. His daily life is spent among indifferent people and routine, until one day he discovers he has the ability to telekinesis. But even with his superpowers, Anton faces the reality that the world still remains completely indifferent.

1721251.title: Bapak Paling Jujur
1721251.overview: Jonas Prakoso is a young gubernatorial candidate who knows exactly how to sell himself as the ideal leader. With his best friend and campaign manager, Marbun, he carefully manages every move, every statement, and every piece of his public image. Then a curse from his grandmother leaves Jonas completely unable to lie.  Suddenly, he can no longer dodge questions, soften the truth, or say what people want to hear. Whatever is on his mind comes straight out—whether he is talking to his campaign team, his family, political rivals, or the public. As his carefully constructed image begins to collapse, Jonas’ campaign—and his life—descend into chaos.  BAPAK PALING JUJUR is a comedy-drama about an aspiring leader forced to confront the one thing he has always known how to control: the truth. Because, as Jonas quickly discovers, being honest all the time can be far more troublesome than lying.

1724195.title: Sonho Estrangeiro
1724195.overview: In a future where 75% of humanity lives in a virtual reality and the rest remains on an abandoned Earth, an artificial intelligence is unable to recreate images of the physical world. Helena, one of the few people still living outside, is called upon to teach the machine what it cannot comprehend: reality.

1724963.title: A Woman of Good Abilities
1724963.overview: During a nightshift, Rachel is suspected of stealing from a delivery driver which throws her life out of balance.

1725155.title: Por onde você vai
1725155.overview: In a low-key, enigmatic daily life where gestures and quiet moments speak louder than words, Dália, Duda, and Nikki feel almost like ghostly presences. It's a chaotic kind of silence, like vibes echoing through space, imagery, and time.

1725731.title: Andheron Ka Sayya 2
1725731.overview: After the Iron Nail is disturbed once again, terror returns with greater force. As Kaalesha and Dhanraj investigate a series of supernatural events and deadly trials, long-buried secrets surrounding the cursed Katjuri Colony begin to emerge. The deeper they venture into the darkness, the closer they come to an ancient evil determined to consume them all.
1725731.trailerName: Andheron Ka Sayya 2 | Announcement Video | Red Syndicate Production

1730147.title: Happiness Is So Close!
1730147.overview: 80-year-old Jean-Luc is set to play Don Quixote. It's the role he's been waiting for to bid farewell to the stage. Given his health concerns, the production team hires an understudy. Jean-Luc becomes convinced that the understudy is trying to take his place.

1730915.title: Oru Vadakkan Velicham - A Northern Light
1730915.overview: When a young man is taken in for questioning about the disappearance of a woman, a seemingly routine interrogation slowly unravels into something far more personal. As hidden relationships, buried secrets, and long-suppressed truths begin to surface, the lines between justice, guilt, and revenge become increasingly blurred. Set against the backdrop of Canada, Oru Vadakkan Velicham is a Malayalam investigative thriller that explores deception, trauma, and the consequences of the past.
1730915.trailerName: Oru Vadakkan Velicham  | Official OTT  Trailer | manoramaMAX | July 12

1731875.title: Duplicate
1731875.overview: Jan, a withdrawn programmer, works at a successful IT company while struggling with social anxiety. His world is turned upside down when a new employee, Vuk-Janko, joins the company looking exactly like him and gradually begins to take over his life. As Jan attempts to uncover the truth, the line between paranoia and reality becomes increasingly blurred. He is ultimately forced to confront a troubling question: has he truly fallen victim to a conspiracy, or has he simply always been invisible to those around him?

1732131.title: CIRCA 1919: A Hollywood Murder
1732131.overview: On the production of the first western epic, a story-hungry journalist gets her break when a "prop gun" kills an actor.

1733475.title: Man Wearing a Helmet
1733475.overview: As Aboriginal boys are stolen from their families and brought to a rural mission, astonishingly visceral and discomforting truths about our collective past emerge.

1735459.title: Ibu, Bagaimana Aku Tanpamu?
1735459.overview: Plot under wraps. Based on a book with the same title.

1739235.title: Buried in the Snow
1739235.overview: The world above ground and the world below.  Below the horizon, there exists a world that belongs neither to the present, future, nor past, surrounded by boulders and waterfalls, where departed life secretly continues its activities. The spirits of those atomic life forms flow in the meandering water, formless yet remembering the past.  Above the horizon, all things that continue to live continue to live. A gust of wind blows, a flurry of snow falls, waiting for winter to pass, waiting for the sun to rise. Memory, like a giant tendril, rises from the ground, its roots seeping into the soil with the melting snow.  Having been here, yet never truly here.  This is a film poem commemorating the passing of a dear friend from my youth. The poem was hand-engraved on a 400-foot-long roll of film.​

1740387.title: Acharya
1740387.overview: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.
1740387.trailerName: ACHARYA || Movie Official Teaser 2026 || Nikhil Upreti, Purnika Sijapati, Deep Raj Rana, Pramod

1742499.title: People & Things
1742499.overview: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

1743331.title: Isn't It Called True Love?
1743331.overview: Harry, a young tradie relives moments of love and loss, confronting the question of what someone would do for love once its gone?
1743331.trailerName: Isn't It Called True Love? (Short Film 2026) | Crowdfunding Campaign

1746787.title: Miss Intrams
1746787.overview: A queer transmasc college student enters the campus Miss Intramurals pageant not to win, but to understand: is this who she is? Or is this the farewell to who she was?

1752355.title: Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend
1752355.overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

1752739.title: Thank You For Your Interest
1752739.overview: The story of one man's journey through unemployment and job searching. His day is full of new opportunities for his future, and brutal reminders that the path forward isn't exactly straight.

1753891.title: Jumpin' Dublin
1753891.overview: A film about the elite set attracted to all things equestrian in Ireland which attracts luminaries such as Maeve Binchy, Mick and Bianca Jagger, Lady Iveagh, Garech Browne and Lady Zara Jellicoe at a Hunt Ball and at a dinner in Luggala Estate.

1757539.title: Silent Traces
1757539.overview: Faris, a teenager raised by a single father after losing his mother at a young age, grows up believing that he is no longer valued. His father's constant busyness causes every attempt to seek attention and affection to end in disappointment. However, an unexpected loss forces Faris to see a side of his father that he had misunderstood all along. Beneath his father's silence and stern demeanor lies the love and unwavering support he had always longed for, leaving Faris with profound regret and an apology that can never be spoken.

1757987.title: To Escape
1757987.overview: Built from classic prison films, To Escape follows a man’s relentless attempt to break free, turning a jailbreak into a story about the will to keep going.

1762979.title: The Name Game
1762979.overview: Determined to reveal a dark family secret to Jerron, Charlotte plays the cursed name-chanting game her grandmother swore off in the 1950’s South.

1763619.title: The Braggart
1763619.overview: When the wealthy and arrogant Al-Dhahabi family realizes that they are less wealthy than they thought, they are forced to pretend to be wealthy in order to maintain their social status.
1763619.trailerName: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke | Official Trailer | Netflix

1765155.title: Sweet Vertigo: Now Another Enemy
1765155.overview: Six months after losing their chocolate, two young people prepare for a final mission: to reclaim what was taken from them. But upon infiltrating their old rival's lair, they discover that the craving for chocolate could have far greater consequences than they imagined.

1765347.title: Kappa-Tiran
1765347.overview: A controversial thriller set within the shadowy, insular, and institutionally shielded world of fraternities and sororities and its banned tradition of hazing.
